## Standard University Course

Several modules in the RSE curriculum correspond to **well-established courses that are already
offered at most universities** — for example *Requirements Engineering*, *Software Architecture*,
*Software Testing*, and *Machine Learning*. For these, the curriculum deliberately does **not**
prescribe a bespoke, RSE-specific module description.

Instead, departments are expected to slot in their existing course of the same name (or a close
equivalent) to cover the required ECTS. This keeps the curriculum lightweight, avoids duplicating
mature teaching material, and reserves the detailed, RSE-specific module descriptions for the
genuinely new competencies of the programme.

When selecting a concrete course, make sure it covers the standard body of knowledge for the topic
and matches the ECTS listed in the curriculum table.
